sloka: एवं स राजा सुमहान्हतः सबलवाहनः ।शूलस्य तु बलं सौम्य अप्रमेयमनुत्तमम् ।। ७.६७.२२ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ sa rājā sumahānhataḥ sabalavāhanaḥ ।śūlasya tu balaṁ saumya aprameyamanuttamam ।। 7.67.22 ॥

translations.english: Thus, that very great king was killed along with his army and vehicles; indeed, O gentle one, the power of that trident is immeasurable and unsurpassed.
